title: デビュー戦の後に・帝王、発進！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finishing her debut, Tokai Teio feels a sense of growth as she takes her first step in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Teio holds a training session with Air Groove, who points out her lack of experience but praises her potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She still has a lot of room for improvement. If she's going to take on Symboli Rudolf, she'll have to show considerable power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To prove herself, she aims to conquer the Classics and claim the same title as Symboli Rudolf before her: that of Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before she aims for the first of the formidable Classics, we decide she should test her skills with the Wakagoma Stakes.
